dogecoin.text: Update on $DOGE. Looks like a 5 wave uptrend is complete, so lets focus on the correction. 5 waves down so far, so could be a 5-3-5 zig zag, with the C wave up around 65 cents, before the next 5 wave move down. Just one possibility, and will have to watch this one closely! #DOGE https://t.co/eYhdPSpVQ6

$DOGE 5 wave move completed, followed by a Zig Zag A-B-C correction - A: 5 waves down, B: 3 waves up, and C: 5 waves down.

Can't see completion of wave C, but expect around 20c when it happens. Likely influenced by $BTC price action so lets wait and see.
